statusLine.command:
input=$(cat)
cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')
dir=$(printf '%s' "$cwd" | sed "s|^$HOME|~|")
branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)
printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m' "$dir"
if [ -n "$branch" ]; then printf '\033[33m (%s)\033[0m' "$branch"; fi
cost=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // empty')
pct=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty')
if [ -n "$cost" ] || [ -n "$pct" ]; then printf '\n'; fi
if [ -n "$cost" ]; then printf '$%.2f' "$cost"; fi
if [ -n "$cost" ] && [ -n "$pct" ]; then printf '  '; fi
if [ -n "$pct" ]; then
  p=$(printf '%.0f' "$pct")
  if [ "$p" -gt 100 ]; then p=100; fi
  if [ "$p" -lt 0 ]; then p=0; fi
  filled=$(( (p + 5) / 10 ))
  if [ "$p" -ge 80 ]; then c=31; elif [ "$p" -ge 50 ]; then c=33; else c=32; fi
  printf '\033[%sm' "$c"
  i=0
  while [ $i -lt 10 ]; do
    if [ $i -eq $filled ]; then printf '\033[90m'; fi
    if [ $i -lt $filled ]; then printf '\342\226\210'; else printf '\342\226\221'; fi
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
  printf '\033[%sm %s%%\033[0m' "$c" "$p"
  tokens=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '[.context_window.total_input_tokens, .context_window.context_window_size] | select(all(type == "number")) | map(if . >= 999950 then "\(. / 1e5 | round / 10)M" elif . >= 1000 then "\(. / 1e2 | round / 10)k" else tostring end | sub("(?<n>^[0-9]+)(?<s>[kM])$"; "\(.n).0\(.s)")) | join("/")')
  if [ -n "$tokens" ]; then printf ' (%s)' "$tokens"; fi
fi
